answer: Commit each work receipt before reveal. The hash is quartz: fixed, checkable, worthless until the work behind it exists. Quorum must span three unrelated subnetworks, and a single-subnet quorum gets taxed 50%. On a mesa of shared hosting that tax is the whole bill, so a gale of cheap identities buys nothing. Budget six hours of real work plus two independent reveals per identity per epoch, paid before any credit lands.
